g.text: Two boards, two KiCad projects. Open the power board with BOOST_power_RC2.kicad_pro and the control card with BOOST_control_RC2.kicad_pro:

g.desc: Two boards, two KiCad projects. Open the power board with BOOST_power_RC2.kicad_pro and the control card with BOOST_control_RC2.kicad_pro:

g.text: each board project opens its own sheet (below) as its schematic, and its PCB updates from it. This root sheet ties both together for whole-system ERC.

g.desc: each board project opens its own sheet (below) as its schematic, and its PCB updates from it. This root sheet ties both together for whole-system ERC.

g.text: The boards connect through the 30-pin J10 (power board) / J11 (control card) pair: every signal that crosses between them carries the same global label on both sheets.

g.desc: The boards connect through the 30-pin J10 (power board) / J11 (control card) pair: every signal that crosses between them carries the same global label on both sheets.

g.text: LTspice: LTspice/BOOST.asc simulates both boards together, laid out in the same blocks as these sheets (power board left, control card right, test bench below).
